image_description: A close-up view of a fabric baby bib hanging on the back of a wooden chair. The bib features a high-contrast black and white floral pattern (resembling sunflowers or daisies) with a dark blue or black trim around the neck opening. The edges appear to have a white serged or zigzag stitch finish. The background consists of the vertical slats of a wooden chair.
